name: PSR/cold-trap classification and trapping-kernel verification
purpose: Verify permanent-shadow classification and species-specific irreversible/finite-residence trapping rules.
production_capability: PSR state and cold-trap surface sink/reservoir.
configuration: One-cell 1000-atom Ar inventory, 28 kJ mol^-1 modified Arrhenius law, 1-day declared retention timescale, 40 K then 150 K one-hour steps.
independent_reference: Boolean classification truth table and independently evaluated residence/trapping inequalities.
frame_time_convention: Lunar body-fixed location and declared epoch/illumination history.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic classifications; fixed seeds/counts for probabilistic trapping.
procedure: Advance the same continuous inventory through a cold and warm interval, require greater warm release without an irreversible sink, and close the atom budget.
acceptance_criteria: Exact analytical classifications and closed inventory; observational thresholds must be frozen from metadata/literature.
expected_pass_result: Only physically eligible cold locations trap and budgets close.
data_hashes: none; D02/D03 classification and site scoring belong to I20
status_semantics: PASS verifies reversible local retention and budget closure only; linked terrain/temperature classification and D02/D03 scoring remain I20.
